description.en:
The type of the deployment task.

Valid values:

*   cloud: multi-cloud deployment task.
*   user: cloud service deployment task. This type of task does not support Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置每页显示证书的数量。默认值为**50**。
description.en: The number of certificates per page. Default value: **50**.

The status of the deployment task.

Valid values:

*   success
*   pending
*   scheduling
*   processing
*   error
*   editing

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cas list-deployment-job --job-type user --status pending --current-page 1 --show-size 50 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cas ListDeploymentJob --region cn-hangzhou --Status pending --JobType user --CurrentPage 1 --ShowSize 50
